state.request: Fix the mobile New thread Recent list in Aura: it currently sits directly on the wallpaper with an opaque sticky header band and rows with no separation, which the user dislikes. Render it as an intentional themed card below the wallpaper (rounded surface, bordered, readable in light and dark), with the Recent heading above a hairline rule and hairline dividers between rows instead of the solid band; keep the scroll behavior, keep desktop unchanged, bump Aura to 0.2.8, then release the new version with a PR, merge it, and push the aura/v0.2.8 tag.
